issues.legal_issue: Specific performance may be replaced by a payment reflecting the value of the contracted land where granting the conveyance would cause special hardship.
material_facts: The plaintiffs sought specific performance of a contract for the sale of land.
The plaintiffs were found ready and willing to perform the contract, and the defendant was found to have breached it.
The defendant had built godowns and other costly structures on the land.
The court considered that ordering conveyance would cause special hardship and substituted payment of the approximate present value of the land for a sale deed.
issues.conclusion: The finding that the plaintiffs were ready and willing and that the defendant breached the contract was upheld, but the decree for specific performance was replaced with an order requiring the defendant to pay the plaintiffs the approximate present value of the land.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 20 of the Specific Relief Act, 1963, specific performance is discretionary; where granting it would cause special hardship, the court may decline to order conveyance and instead shape relief to do complete justice. No earlier cases are relied on in the judgment.

rule.if: appeal_from_specific_performance_decree and plaintiffs_ready_and_willing and defendant_breached_contract and defendant_built_costly_structures_on_land_causing_special_hardship

predicates.appeal_from_specific_performance_decree: The proceeding was an appeal from a decree granting specific performance of a land-sale contract.
predicates.plaintiffs_ready_and_willing: The plaintiffs were found ready and willing to perform the contract.
predicates.defendant_breached_contract: The defendant was found to have breached the contract.
predicates.defendant_built_costly_structures_on_lan: The defendant had built costly structures on the contracted land, and requiring conveyance would cause special hardship.
predicates.specific_performance_replaced_with_value: The decree for conveyance is replaced by an order requiring payment of the land's value.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns a decree for specific performance, the plaintiffs were ready and willing, the defendant breached the contract, and the defendant's costly structures on the land make conveyance specially harsh, the conveyance may be replaced by payment of the land's value.
